description: This PHP class 'SmartDefaultSettings' generates and manages CKEditor 5 settings for Drupal text editors and formats, including computing default configurations, matching HTML restrictions, and enabling necessary plugins.

classes.name: SmartDefaultSettings
classes.description: A final class that manages CKEditor 5 default settings, plugin support, and HTML restrictions for Drupal editors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes plugin manager, logger, module handler, and current user.

methods.name: computeSmartDefaultSettings
methods.description: Calculates the closest CKEditor 5 settings matching an existing text editor and format, including plugin enabling and HTML restrictions adjustments.

methods.name: addTagsToSourceEditing
methods.description: Adds support for specific HTML tags to the Source Editing plugin configuration.

methods.name: computeNetNewElementsForPlugin
methods.description: Determines the net new HTML elements a plugin would add and any surplus elements.

methods.name: computeSurplusScore
methods.description: Calculates a score indicating how much surplus a set of HTML restrictions has compared to what's needed.

methods.name: getCandidates
methods.description: Finds candidate plugins to support still-needed HTML restrictions based on current support and plugin capabilities.

methods.name: selectCandidate
methods.description: Selects the best plugin candidate for each needed HTML restriction, minimizing surplus.

methods.name: addToolbarItemsToMatchHtmlElementsInFormat
methods.description: Configures CKEditor 5 toolbar items to match the HTML elements allowed by a text format.

methods.name: addDefaultSettingsForEnabledConfigurablePlugins
methods.description: Adds default configuration settings for all enabled, configurable CKEditor 5 plugins.
